title: Red Dead Redemption
description:
Red Dead Redemption follows former outlaw John Marston after federal agents threaten his family and force him to hunt down surviving members of his former gang. The journey crosses the American West and Mexico during the closing years of the frontier era.

The Nintendo Switch release contains the complete single-player Red Dead Redemption experience together with Undead Nightmare, the supernatural horror campaign in which Marston confronts a zombie outbreak. It also includes additional single-player content from the Game of the Year Edition. Multiplayer from the original release is not included.

nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
nintendoNotes: Nintendo lists one player, 11.6 GB download size, Chinese language support, TV/Tabletop/Handheld play and Save Data Cloud. The package includes the complete single-player Red Dead Redemption campaign, Undead Nightmare and bonus Game of the Year Edition single-player content; multiplayer content is not included. No verified direct Full Wrap was found, so 3D texture fields remain blank.
tagline: Ride across the dying American frontier as John Marston in a story-driven open world that also includes the supernatural Undead Nightmare campaign.
fitFor: Players who want a mature, cinematic Western story with a large open world and memorable characters.
Players who enjoy horseback exploration, gunfights, side activities and emergent encounters.
Players who want Red Dead Redemption and Undead Nightmare together in a portable Nintendo version.
notFitFor: Players primarily looking for the original multiplayer modes; they are not included in this Nintendo Switch release.
Players who require 60 FPS on the original Nintendo Switch version.
Younger players; the game carries a mature age rating and contains strong violence and adult themes.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-World Frontier
gameplayPillars.description: Travel freely through a large Western world filled with settlements, wilderness, side activities, strangers, wildlife and emergent encounters.

gameplayPillars.title: Gunfights and Dead Eye
gameplayPillars.description: Use revolvers, rifles and other period weapons while Dead Eye slows targeting to create precise, cinematic gunfights.

gameplayPillars.title: John Marston’s Story
gameplayPillars.description: Follow a former outlaw forced by federal agents to hunt down the surviving members of the gang he once called family.

worldSummary: Red Dead Redemption is set during the final years of the American frontier. John Marston travels across New Austin, West Elizabeth and northern Mexico through ranches, deserts, frontier towns, forests and lawless settlements. The world supports story missions, hunting, gambling, strangers, bounties, random encounters and travel by horse, train and stagecoach.

storyChapters.title: Hunting the Old Gang
storyChapters.body: Federal agents threaten John Marston’s family and compel him to track down former gang members across the American frontier.

storyChapters.title: Across the Border
storyChapters.body: Marston’s search expands into Mexico, where local conflicts and competing factions draw him deeper into the region’s political violence.

storyChapters.title: Undead Nightmare
storyChapters.body: The included horror campaign transforms the familiar frontier into a supernatural survival crisis filled with the undead.

features: Explore the American frontier and Mexico in a large open world built around towns, wilderness, missions and emergent encounters.
Use the Dead Eye targeting system to slow down combat decisions and mark precise shots during gunfights.
The Nintendo Switch release includes the complete single-player Red Dead Redemption campaign plus Undead Nightmare.
Hunting, bounty work, stranger missions, poker and other side activities expand the campaign beyond story missions.
Horse travel, weapon management and an honor-driven Western narrative define the core single-player loop.
A separate Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is available, but this product entry remains the Nintendo Switch 1 release rather than being relabeled through backward compatibility.

faq.q: Does the Switch release include Undead Nightmare?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo states that Undead Nightmare is included alongside the complete Red Dead Redemption single-player campaign.

faq.q: Does Red Dead Redemption on Switch include multiplayer?
faq.a: No. Nintendo explicitly notes that multiplayer content from the original game is not included.

faq.q: Can the Nintendo Switch version run on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. It is compatible with Nintendo Switch 2, and the current import keeps separate Switch 2 performance information where available.

verdictSummary:
Score note: 8.3/10 is a direct normalization of the current 83/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

The Nintendo Switch release is a strong portable way to experience John Marston’s complete single-player story and Undead Nightmare. Its greatest limitations are the absence of original multiplayer and the original Switch performance ceiling.
verdictPros: Undead Nightmare is included in the package.
Stable portable presentation with the full single-player experience.
verdictCons: Original Switch version is limited to a 30 FPS presentation.
Some mechanics retain the feel of a 2010-era open-world game.
